subject: Request: Exec approval for 25% Hosted API discount for Opsly committed plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Exec approval for 25% Hosted API discount for Opsly committed plan

Team —

Quick background: Opsly (Ben Howard) is asking for a 25% off list discount on Hosted API usage pricing in order to convert to a 24-month committed plan with a $600k committed spend (billing annually). This is above our standard approved discount band (>20%), so I need exec sign-off to proceed.

Why this matters: Opsly is a high-visibility prospect in e-commerce analytics. They expect a large uplift in token volume after integration; they’ve committed to a 24-month onboarding plan and multi-region support. If we hold at sub-20%, there’s a material risk they go to a competitor that has quoted a similar blended rate.

Key commercials they want:
- 24-month commitment, $600k total committed spend (annual billing)
- 25% discount on Hosted API per-token list rates
- 60k free onboarding credits (one-time) — Opsly asks this be included
- Data residency (US) and SOC 2 attestation included

Attachments: Opsly_Usage_Forecast_20260506.xlsx, Draft_SOW_Opsly_redline.pdf (I’ve pulled the forecast and our draft redlines).

Ask: Exec approval to offer 25% off list for Hosted API usage conditioned on:
- minimum $600k committed spend (24 months)
- no additional promotional credits beyond the 60k onboarding credits (one-time)
- accelerated billing (annual in advance) and capped early termination fee to protect our economics

Please reply with APPROVE or DENY and any additional guardrails. If approved, I’ll instruct Legal to update the SOW and instruct Finance to set up the billing terms.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-09T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval for 25% Hosted API discount for Opsly committed plan

Karthik —

Thanks for the concise summary. A few notes from Deal Desk perspective:
- Margin impact: at a 25% off list for Hosted API, blended gross margin on this forecast drops ~8 points vs. baseline.
- Mitigations: require annual in-advance billing (non-negotiable) and a 12% early termination fee on the unbilled committed balance (protects us if they churn year 1). Also recommend removing any usage-based rollover of credits.
- Onboarding credits: okay to grant the one-time 60k credits if we cap their value to a 6-month ramp schedule (i.e., credits expire after month 6).

If leadership approves the 25% concession, I’ll prepare the revised commercial summary and a short margin analysis for Finance.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Deal Desk, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval for 25% Hosted API discount for Opsly committed plan

Quick context from the field: Opsly is in final-stage evaluation with two competitors. Their platform is deeply integrated with our API patterns; their engineering lead flagged vendor lock-in risk if we don’t move on price. The ask for 60k onboarding credits is standard in their RFQ.

I support approving 25% with the following live controls so we don’t set a repeatable precedent:
- Condition approval on signed 24-month MSA + SOW with annual prepayment.
- Add a renewal floor: negotiated rate for year 3 cannot be lower than 85% of the year 2 realized price.
- Require Opsly to complete our onboarding checklist (attachments note the SOW redlines).

If Leadership approves, I’ll confirm commercial summary with Rishi and send the redline to Ben for signature.

-Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval for 25% Hosted API discount for Opsly committed plan

Karthik / team —

I approve the 25% Hosted API discount for Opsly on the conditions noted below. I want to be explicit about the guardrails:
- Must be a signed 24-month MSA + SOW with annual prepayment ($600k committed).
- Limit onboarding credits to 60k and expire them after 6 months; no additional credits or trial extensions.
- Require early termination fee equal to 12% of remaining unbilled committed value.
- Legal to confirm SOC 2 and data residency (US) language; if Legal flags material risk, approval is rescinded until addressed.
- Finance to review the margin impact; if incremental margin drop exceeds 10% vs. target after the final commercial summary, reroute to CFO for sign-off.

Karthik — proceed to send the approved commercial summary to Ben and attach the managed SOW redline. Rishi, please circulate the margin worksheet to finance and include a concise note on assumptions. Marissa, confirm the onboarding checklist and expiry logic in the SOW.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Howard <ben.howard@opsly.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@opsly.com
Date: 2026-05-11T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval for 25% Hosted API discount for Opsly committed plan

Karthik / Marissa —

Thanks — we appreciate the quick turnaround and the conditional approval. Opsly accepts the commercial terms as outlined: 24-month commitment at the 25% discounted rate with annual prepayment and the one-time 60k onboarding credits (we accept the 6-month expiry).

Next steps from our side: I’ve looped in finance to expedite the PO. Please send the final SOW redline and invoice instructions. We’d like to execute by end of month to meet our integration timeline.

Ben Howard
Head of Platform Partnerships, Opsly
